title: Mattermost versions 11.11.x <= 11.11.0, 11.7.x <= 11.7.11, 11.10.x <= 11.10.2 Fail to revoke a user's active sessions…
description: Mattermost versions 11.11.x up to 11.11.0, 11.7.x up to 11.7.11, and 11.10.x up to 11.10.2 have a vulnerability where active user sessions are not revoked during a bulk import operation that links an existing user account to a bot record or changes the account's authentication service or data. This allows an attacker with a previously issued session token to maintain full authenticated access to the affected account after the import.
